To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
public participation in EAI is more likely to be successful when it is carried out in a systematic and participatory manner.
NGOs tend to involve public participation in EIIAs more than government organizations.
public participation in NGO's run projects is much more effective than the GOs' projects.
In summary, our research is concerned with
public participation in EIIA, and how it differs between government and non-government projects.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the public participation in EAI is not yet a common practice in Bangladesh and there is still a lot of scope of improvement in this sector.
public participation in EAI is a must to ensure the success of any project.
, in the case of EIA, the government and NGOs have to work together in order to ensure the public participation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
public participation in EIIA is not a matter of 'yes' or 'no', but it should be a continuous and dynamic process.
public participation is an essential part in any EIA process.
, public participation is not only a right but also an obligation to be practiced in all the stages of an EAI, especially when a project is being implemented by NGOs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NGOs can play a pivotal role in public participation in EAI, and thus can contribute to sustainable development.
NGOs can be a better choice for ensuring public participation in EAI, as their approach is more participative than the conventional government run project.
public participation should be ensured at all stages of EIA, not just at the beginning or end.
